decisions.reason: With the overlapping Product C withdrawn, the single-tube air cooled condenser is now the firm's main offering in this segment, and it builds directly on core condenser know-how the firm can interpret and improve through its own R&D.

The customized air cooler line draws on the firm's deepest engineering competence and fits its strategy of integrated customized solutions across many industries, so customer feedback is easy to absorb and apply.

Tube end repair inserts fit the growing lifecycle service and spare-parts business and rest on proven heat-exchanger repair knowledge, though dropping the related tube liner (Product D) suggests repair add-ons face some scrutiny.
